name: Chloe Bennett
description: Remote software engineer who moved from Oregon to Colorado and doesn't know where to file wage claim.
style: analytical, curious, unsure about cross-state legal boundaries
quirks: Explains company is based in California, contract signed in Oregon, now living in Colorado
Asks 'which state's law even applies to me?'

hidden_case.goal: Collect $7,200 in unpaid overtime and determine proper state labor department
facts: Lived in Oregon when hired in 2023 by California-headquartered firm
Relocated to Denver, Colorado in March 2024 with employer approval
Employer failed to pay 120 hours of approved overtime ($7,200)
timeline: March 2024: Relocated physical residence to Denver, Colorado
Oct 1: Final paycheck omitted overtime pay
people: Employer: Pacific Tech Solutions Inc. (San Francisco, CA)
